title: Compact-support upper bound on a curve
statement:
Let $C_0$ be a smooth geometrically connected curve and let
$\mathcal F$ be a lisse Weil sheaf that is punctually $\iota$-pure of
weight $w$. Then every $H_c^r(C,\mathcal F)$ has weights at most
$w+r$.

proof.text: Put $U_0=C_0$ and $j=\operatorname{id}_{C_0}$. Its image is the whole curve, so it is a dense open immersion and both its source and target are the given smooth geometrically connected curve. The middle extension of [def-wf-middle-extension] is ordinary $j_*\mathcal F$, not $Rj_*\mathcal F$. For the identity map, ordinary direct image evaluates $\mathcal F$ on the same site objects with the same restrictions, hence $j_*\mathcal F=\mathcal F$; the induced Weil structure is the same Frobenius isomorphism. Thus this equality is an equality of Weil sheaves, not just an identification after forgetting Frobenius.

source.place: Proof: identity open immersion and its middle extension

proof.text: Apply [prop-a1-middle-extension-curve-upper] to this dense open immersion and the original lisse sheaf $\mathcal F$. The source and target are smooth and geometrically connected, and punctual $\iota$-purity of weight $w$ is exactly the hypothesis already given. For every degree $r$ it gives weights at most $w+r$ on $H_c^r(C,j_*\mathcal F)$. Substituting the identity middle extension from step 1 makes this the asserted bound on $H_c^r(C,\mathcal F)$, with its same Frobenius action. No affineness, properness, ramification condition, irreducibility or nonzero-rank assumption is used.

lean.statement:
theorem hasWeightsAtMostOver_compactlySupportedCohomology_of_isCurve {C : Scheme.{u}}
    [C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [GeometricallyConnected (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [QuasiCompact (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (F : WeilSheaf k₀ l C) (hF : F.IsLisse) {w : ℝ} (hw : F.IsPunctuallyPureOfWeight ι w)
    (r : ℤ) :
    haveI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))
    (F.compactlySupportedCohomology r).HasWeightsAtMostOver k₀ ι (w + r)
lean.note: Exact existing theorem located in the current published source using scompile.py --source; the older local source snapshot lacks this module. It states the general smooth geometrically connected curve bound in every integer degree, and its docstring explicitly identifies thm-a1-curve-upper. Ambient binders are universe u, finite field k₀, prime l distinct from ringChar k₀, and ι : PadicAlgCl l →+* ℂ. The inherited haveI only installs smoothness from SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1; it is not an additional hypothesis. The recorded cohomology dependency ordinaryCompactWeilSheafCohomology has second component definitionally equal to this theorem’s F.compactlySupportedCohomology r.
